categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Jizhi Mechatronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing, design, and sales of fully automatic balancing machines, testing machines, and automation equipment. These products serve industries including electric motors, automotive rotating parts, household appliances, power tools, pumps, fans, turbines, gas turbines, and aerospace engines. The company also develops intelligent sensing systems and automation production lines for electric motor manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include dynamic balancing detection and automatic correction of rotating parts using cutting and laser weight removal methods. It has proprietary sensor design, precise positioning, mathematical modeling, automatic tool alignment, and dynamic density compensation technologies. Production involves mechanical and electrical system assembly, with parts machining outsourced to specialized third parties, enabling focus on core R&D and design. The company also integrates PLC-based control systems for robustness in harsh manufacturing environments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers in electric motor production, automotive rotating parts, household appliances, power tools, pumps, fans, turbines, gas turbines, and aerospace engine components. Major clients include Bosch, Gree, Midea, Nidec, and various automotive and shipbuilding enterprises. The company targets expanding markets such as new energy vehicles, industrial robots, and low-altitude aviation equipment, leveraging its products for balancing and automation needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations and sales are concentrated in China, especially in East China and South China regions, with growing overseas sales. It has subsidiaries and facilities in Shanghai, Hangzhou, Xi’an, Changsha, and India, supporting both domestic and international markets. The company is expanding its international footprint, aiming to enter global markets with high-end balancing and automation equipment.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Jizhi Mechatronic operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying specialized balancing machines and automation equipment used by downstream manufacturers of electric motors and rotating parts. It also provides technical services and maintenance, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier within the industrial manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment in high-speed and ultra-high-speed balancing technologies, automation production lines, and intelligent sensing systems. It pursues innovation in dynamic balancing measurement precision, digitalization, and intelligent control. Strategic R&D projects include intelligent underwater acoustic sensing, laser weight removal balancing for micro motors, automated balancing for automotive components, and development of high-speed rotor balancing for turbines and aerospace engines. The company also focuses on expanding applications in emerging industries like robotics and low-altitude aviation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of fully automatic balancing machines, testing machines, and automation equipment. Additional income streams include sales of accessories such as cutting tools, fixtures, sensors, and ceramics, as well as technical development services and equipment maintenance. The company mainly uses direct sales channels domestically and self-operated exports internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China’s fully automatic balancing machine market, with strong brand recognition and technical capabilities. It competes with international firms like Germany’s Schenck in high-speed balancing equipment. Its competitive advantages include patented technologies, cost-effective products with performance comparable or superior to foreign competitors, and a comprehensive service network. The company is recognized as a key supplier to major domestic and international manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 268.6 million, a 5.38% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 19.1 million, reflecting a 41.65% decrease. Total assets grew by 30.86% to RMB 1.386 billion. R&D expenses accounted for 16.2% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation. The company has issued convertible bonds raising RMB 254.6 million to fund expansion projects. Despite profit fluctuations, the company maintains a stable growth trajectory and expanding asset base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, fully automatic balancing machines tailored to diverse rotating parts with broad applicability and high repeatability. Its products feature patented sensor designs, flexible fixture technologies, and robust PLC-based control systems suited for challenging manufacturing environments. It provides cost-effective solutions with performance on par or better than international competitors, supported by a strong brand, extensive customer service network, and continuous innovation. This combination enables customers to improve product quality, reduce vibration and noise, extend equipment life, and enhance production efficiency.
